content.heading: One accountable structure for the whole build.
content.lead: From early coordination to site completion, Igloo Construction brings engineering, procurement, site management and secondary works into one delivery rhythm.
paragraphs: Our general contracting scope is grounded in real residential, mixed-use and commercial programmes delivered by the Igloo team across Algeria.
The delivery model adapts to the programme: coordinating trades, sequencing site activities, maintaining quality controls and keeping the built result aligned with the brief.
